message:
2 `host` bindings do not parse:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Unexpected token '{' at column 8 in [Delete {{ items().length }} rows] in [attr.title]
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: PctWidget — Parser Error: Host binding expression cannot contain pipes[label() | uppercase] in [attr.placeholder]
description: Two `host` bindings the binding parser refuses, as `ngc` does: an interpolation, which a `host` block takes none of, and a pipe, which a host binding cannot contain (measured: JIT throws a parser error on each). What the parser makes of such a value is no reading of the expression, and the first one's words would pass point 3 unread; so point 1 refuses both, by class and by the parser's message.
